newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria uncovers legion of "ghost workers".
newsitem.headline: Nigeria uncovers legion of "ghost workers".

text.p: Twenty-two Nigerian government clerks who stole 10 million naira ($125,000) monthly as salaries to 8,000 "ghost workers" fled after their scheme was uncovered, a minister said.
"We got 22 of them, all finance clerks. They ran away," Works Minister Major-General Abdulkareem Adisa told the official Daily Times newspaper in a report published on Monday.
The phenomenon of "ghost workers" has long plagued the Nigerian public service and the present government introduced a "pay by sight" system two years ago to fish out non-existent workers.
Adisa said although the system had delayed staff salaries it had established that his ministry had 30,000 staff and not 38,000 as he was told when he assumed office in 1995.
